Noble Dragon Lord Longsword — Crafting Recipe & Materials

Everything you need to craft Noble Dragon Lord Longsword in AION 2: the direct recipe, the full base-material shopping list summed across every sub-craft, and where to get each material.

Korea/Taiwan data (client v110, 2026-09-09). Not in the Global client as of 2026-09-19. Materials and quantities may differ when it releases.

KR/TWGrade: HeroicProfession: Blacksmithing

Noble Dragon Lord Longsword recipe — direct components

  • Artisan's Ultimate Refining Stone×18
  • Fine Robust Balaur Horn×122
  • Wrathful Belief×40
  • Wrathful Flame×40
  • Maddened Wrathful Curse×19
  • Radiant Orichalcum Ore×46
  • Radiant Odyle×26
  • Kina (All)×50,000,000
  • Transfer Stone: Weapon (Heroic) (Bound)×1

All base materials for Noble Dragon Lord Longsword

Every sub-recipe expanded — this is the complete shopping list of raw materials to gather, farm or buy (123 total crafts).
